answer: Concretely, the economy can force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the opal to sunk effort, uses the prism as an corroborating signal, then requires a meadow before any payout.
